ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels vs 30% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central regions of both lobes consist of contiguous high-intensity white blobs. Low-intensity black banding is present along the entire perimeter of the trailing and leading edges. Significant irregular mottling and vertical streaking are concentrated in the interior region of the right lobe and along the lower base of the fluke.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated interior angle of approximately 48 degrees with a vertical depth roughly 1/6th of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Primary boundary exhibits moderate micro-serration; low-amplitude variations (3-8 pixels) are consistent across the trailing edge, with increased irregularity and larger protrusions near the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature extending from the median notch toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-contrast, textured white/tan pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. A distinct dark circular ring-shaped anomaly is visible on the upper-mid section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous multi-directional, dark linear pixel tracks (rake marks) are prominent on the lower-left lobe and the central-right lobe, crossing the primary white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring across both lobes; significant barnacle colonization on the distal tips; circular scar on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique diagonal 'brush-stroke' style pigmentation pattern on the inner right lobe near the median notch.
